messages:
maria: quick UX check  thinking about pause/stop placement in Playground streaming: overlay top-right vs inline footer, token counter visibility, and a small resume/undo toast.

ash: overlay top-right reduces layout shifts. mobile should fall back to inline footer action.

rae: agree. token counter as a tiny pill bottom-left of message while streaming (~120 tokens). tooltip shows Visible / Billable estimate.

dev: impl notes: throttle counter to 200ms, add pauseStream(id)/resumeStream(id,token) APIs. undo will attempt resume from cache, otherwise re-run.

priya: a11y: per-message aria-live="polite", on pause move focus to toast Resume button and announce "Stream paused; final partial content available." when resuming announce "Resuming stream". ensure overlay control is keyboard focusable and labelled.

maria: copy: use "Pause stream" and toast: "Stream paused  Resume". schedule a quick review after mocks + proto. :thumbsup: 

a11y-bot: reminder: include role=status for toast and document live-region throttling in PR description.
